description: Dispatch keyboard key event or combination (Enter, Tab, Escape, Control+A, Control+Shift+R...) to active element or selector. Supports inline post-key waitMs/waitForSelector/waitForText and includeSnapshot.

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

includeSnapshot.description: Capture and return an interactive page snapshot after pressing key (default: false)

sleepMs.description: Alias for waitMs: milliseconds to sleep after pressing key

waitForSelector.description: Optional CSS selector or @ref to wait for after pressing key

waitForText.description: Optional text to wait for on the page after pressing key

waitMs.description: Optional milliseconds to wait/sleep after pressing key
